description_en: Queries all archive rules under a specified analyzer
description_zh: 查询指定分析器下的所有归档规则
kebab_example: aliyun accessanalyzer list-archive-rules --analyzer-name MyAnalyzer --max-results 10 --next-token eyJpbmRleCI6IjIifQ== --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListArchiveRules

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of archive rules to return in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回的最大归档规则数量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页标记，首次请求不填，后续请求使用上一次返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token
